    snapshotText: snapshotBox ? snapshotBox.innerText : null,
    tableRows: rows.slice(0, 15)
  };
}",

}

{
  "function": "() => {
  const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*="tableContentRow"]'));
  
  return rows.map((r, i) => {
    const text = r.innerText;
    // Extract title
    const titleEl = r.querySelector('a[href*="/dp/"]');
    const asinMatch = text.match(/ASIN\s*([A-Z0-9]{10})/i);
    const skuMatch = text.match(/SKU\s*([^\n]+)/i);
    const fnskuMatch = text.match(/FNSKU\s*([^\n]+)/i);
    const upcMatch = text.match(/UPC\s*([0-9]+)/i);
    const statusMatch = text.match(/(在售|缺货|不可售|停售)/);
    
    // Check icons/alerts
    const alerts = Array.from(r.querySelectorAll('kat-icon, [class*="alert"], [class*="warning"]')).map(el => el.getAttribute('name') || el.className).filter(Boolean);
    
    return {
      index: i,
      title: titleEl ? titleEl.innerText : null,
      asin: asinMatch ? asinMatch[1] : null,
      sku: skuMatch ? skuMatch[1] : null,
      fnsku: fnskuMatch ? fnskuMatch[1] : null,
      upc: upcMatch ? upcMatch[1] : null,
      status: statusMatch ? statusMatch[1] : null,
      alerts: alerts.length > 0 ? alerts : 'None',
      textSnippet: text
    };
  });
}",
  "pageId": 3
}
